notes.title: Update 20.0
notes.notes:
1 - Game saving and loading are now available{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/7c4604891a431e063de39c6720ea39ed03b54344.png

2 - Mega ships have been rebalanced. Updated the science system for researching mega ships (each ship now has its own dedicated science branch)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/68db1337ba68cd4f2d05ecf913349d0fb8e302f2.png

3 - Pilots (regardless of type—fearless, standard, or coward) will now repair their ships to 90%+ health before heading out on adventures
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/2e341015440c32c035ff470dea0ed0c6911be32d.png

4 - Added an extensive text-based tutorial
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/83ae3e3d040e81d1bff984039cced943d8133b37.png

5 - Fixed several UI bugs related to starting new missions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/2de9b64ccf48b440b332799a6c797581617e6b39.png

6 - Slightly rebalanced some missions and fixed bugs in certain missions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/516607cfbf6f6bc2b49296c1d8a564ede3f3b368.png

7 - The invisibility item has been replaced with a temporary (1.5 sec) invulnerability item
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/363633c37c1a661186541c88e3d43831e111269b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926624/751464f6235d6fd581f2509bd6c0e73e8b5981fb.png

notes.title: Update 19.8
notes.notes:
Interface fixes:
Improved tooltips
Improved science window
Added Esc handling

Tutorial:
Skipping a task counts as completing it
Now you can turn on the tutorial video at any time
